{{Quote|We are still analyzing the data from the attack, but we can confirm that General Ares Nune's task force did encounter enemy forces on patrol.|A [[Unidentified Republic admiral|Republic Navy official]] reports on the battle|<ref name="A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] patrol of the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]], overseen by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] was also in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], and quickly eradicated Nune's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. Following the attack, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] led a task force of several [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|find and destroy]] the Confederate weapon.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I compiled all the reports, seeing if there's any pattern so we can find whatever it is the Seppies are doing out here.''"<br />"''Well done, Snips.''"<br />"''Not well enough. It's just too ''random''.|Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], on tracking the Confederate weapon's strike points|<ref name="Shakedown" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], that was capable of destroying numerous [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. The [[Ion cannon/Legends|cannons]] neutralized all power in their targets, leaving them defenseless and vulnerable without the ability to use [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] to protect themselves. That, in turn, allowed the ''Malevolence'' to destroy its unprotected prey with its numerous [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> The Confederacy soon began to use the ''Malevolence'' in [[Malevolence Campaign/Legends|numerous strikes]] on Republic task forces that left no survivors. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] became increasingly worried with the losses,<ref name="Shakedown" /> and the attacks sowed fear among the citizens of the Republic,<ref name="A Galaxy Divided" /> even more so because the targets were unpredictable and did not form a pattern.<ref name="Shakedown" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Commander Kite, all hands to escape pods! Abandon ship! Abandon ship! Abandon ship!|A recording retrieved from the battle|<ref name="A Galaxy Divided" />}}
[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ares Nune/Legends|Ares Nune]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Kite (clone trooper)|Kite]] took three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="Shakedown" />&mdash;including Nune's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Laudable]]''<ref name="Prelude" />&mdash;on a regular patrol of the [[Phu system/Legends|Phu system]]. However, the ''Malevolence'' was also in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], under the command of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general immediately ordered the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannons to fire.<ref name="Shakedown" /> As the ion wave obliterated the shields of the ''Laudable'', Nune ordered [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Kite to organize an evacuation of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] via [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="Contradictory">Both ''[[The Clone Wars: Shakedown]]'' and ''[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided]]'' are somewhat contradictory of each other. In the comic, the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion pulse immediately neutralizes Nune's fleet, while a recording played during the ''HoloNet News'' podcast states that the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannons initially eliminate the shields of the cruisers in Nune's fleet, but that the cruisers themselves were not immediately destroyed. The podcast goes to imply that Nune and his forces then attempted to retreat before falling to the ''Malevolence''. This article follows the latter's interpretation of events</ref> However, the ''Malevolence'' moved in and destroyed the vessels before Nune and his crew of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] could escape.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Finding it is one thing. Finding a way to stop it is another.|Mace Windu, on the Confederate superweapon|<ref name="Shakedown" />}}
The defeat of Nune's fleet was reported in the [[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|HoloNet News]], resulting in increasingly widespread concern among the Republic citizenry. A recording that was taken from the lead ship during the battle survived, and was played during the broadcast.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided" /> Following the report of the loss, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] met with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|office]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Koon volunteered to take several ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to find and destroy the "mystery weapon," as the ''Malevolence'' had been dubbed. Aboard the Star Destroyer [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']],<ref name="Shakedown" /> Koon tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]] and engaged it in [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|battle]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the Phu system was featured in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shakedown|''Shakedown'']], which was released on [[October 2]], [[2008]] and led into "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']]," one of the episodes featured in the [[October 3]], 2008 premiere of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series on [[Cartoon Network]]. The battle was also mentioned in the [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report [[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|''A Galaxy Divided'']], an ongoing [[Wikipedia:Podcast|podcast]] featuring ''The Clone Wars'' series that was also released on October 2, via [[StarWars.com]] and [[Wikipedia:iTunes|iTunes]].<ref name="HoloNet News Returns">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>
